memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: symptomatic fatigue, tingling toes; B12 pending.
- Plan: check serum B12, MCV, Hb; start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; advise meat, eggs, dairy; weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm male cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 150 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).
MCV: 98 fL (ref 80‑100).
Haemoglobin: 13.2 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
Duration: 3 months
Take after food.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: improved energy, tingling less; B12 result awaited.
- Plan: continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; repeat B12, MCV, Hb; reinforce B12‑rich diet; weight 77.5 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 380 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).
MCV: 92 fL (ref 80‑100).
Haemoglobin: 13.8 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: asymptomatic, B12 within normal.
- Plan: reduce methylcobalamin to 1000 mcg OD; check B12 in 3 months; diet advice: include fortified cereals; weight 77 kg, waist 89 cm (<90 cm).
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
methylcobalamin 1000 mcg OD
Duration: 3 months
Take after food.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: well, no neurologic symptoms.
- Plan: maintain methylcobalamin 1000 mcg OD; repeat B12, MCV, Hb; continue balanced diet; weight 76.8 kg, waist 88 cm.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 460 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).
MCV: 90 fL (ref 80‑100).
Haemoglobin: 14.0 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: occasional mild nausea after supplement; B12 adequate.
- Plan: hold methylcobalamin for 2 weeks to assess nausea; re‑check B12; emphasize natural B12 sources; weight 76.5 kg, waist 87 cm.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 500 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).
MCV: 89 fL (ref 80‑100).
Haemoglobin: 14.1 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Dear Clinic, I stopped the B12 tablets two weeks ago as advised. The nausea has gone, but I feel a little more tired today. Should I restart the tablets or wait for the next test? Thanks, Ramesh.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: fatigue mild, B12 borderline high.
- Plan: discontinue methylcobalamin; check B12 in 3 months to ensure levels stay adequate; diet: continue eggs, fish, fortified cereals; weight 76.0 kg, waist 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
methylcobalamin: stopped
No further supply advised.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-09-10 at 10:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) to review B12 levels and symptoms.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency:
- Status: asymptomatic, B12 within normal range after stopping supplement.
- Plan: no B12 supplementation needed; repeat B12 in 6 months; maintain balanced diet; weight 75.8 kg, waist 85 cm.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.
